title: Reading at a saturated input position
statement: Let $w$ be a Boolean word, let $k$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a state type, and let $c$ be a configuration on input $w$ with $k$ work tapes. For any $j\in\mathbb N$, if the input head of $c$ is at the saturated position $\min(j,|w|)+1$, then the scanned symbol is the $j$-th bit of $w$ when $j<|w|$, and no symbol is read when $j\ge |w|$.
hypotheses_covered: the input-head position of $c$ equals the saturated position for $j$
replaced:
In any configuration whose input head is at the saturated position for $j$
on input $w$, the symbol read is the $j$-th bit of $w$ when $j < \abs{w}$ and
the blank otherwise.
